name: API Cache Cascade
subtitle: Redis degradation causes database amplification and API failure

events.title: Cache memory saturation
events.description: Redis memory usage crossed 85 percent and eviction pressure increased.

events.title: Cache connection pool exhausted
events.description: Application workers could no longer acquire Redis connections.

events.title: Database query amplification
events.description: Cache bypass increased database load by 9x and saturated primary connections.

events.title: Cache nodes recycled
events.description: Redis shard restarted and connection pools stabilized.

narrative.executiveSummary: Redis instability caused the checkout API to fall back to the database, producing a short but severe latency incident.
narrative.technicalSummary: Connection pool exhaustion in the cache layer caused request amplification against PostgreSQL. Database saturation then propagated back into the API tier until the cache cluster was recycled.
narrative.rootCause: Redis memory pressure and stale connection reuse caused repeated cache connection failures under load.
actions: Add cache connection pool health metrics and alerts
Apply request shedding before falling back to the database
Load test cache failure paths during peak traffic simulations
